acceleration_method: Difference against latest earlier source row at least 0.5 s away, at most 5 s away, within same trip and uninterrupted speed segment; past values only.
fuel_density_note: Engineering assumption for gasoline/E10, not measured in VED. Estimated litres scale inversely with this density.
fuel_assumption: Gasoline/E10; exclude explicitly diesel, flex-fuel and unknown engine configurations.
target_method: MAF * (1 + mean(STFT banks)/100 + mean(LTFT banks)/100) / AFR * 3600 / fuel_density_g_per_l
alignment: Use supplied row values only. No forward fill, backward fill or interpolation. VED lacks per-signal acquisition timestamps, so the age of repeated values cannot be verified.
